# Penloom Studio

> Penloom Studio (Naples, FL) is a small studio of focused brands: plain-language AI lessons, verified history stories, wearable-history apparel, and plain-English law news. Free lessons and notes are published at https://penloomstudio.com/.

## Brands
- [Cogloom](https://penloomstudio.com/landing-cogloom-motion.html): free, plain-language AI lessons for beginners and developers
- [Liberty Line](https://penloomstudio.com/landing-liberty-line-motion.html): short, sourced true stories about America's founding and its 250th anniversary
- [Penloom History](https://penloomstudio.com/landing-penloom-history-motion.html): verified dark-history stories
- [Faith & Founding](https://penloomstudio.com/landing-faith-founding-motion.html): pastors and faith in the American Revolution, with sourced quotes
- [Threadlore](https://penloomstudio.com/landing-threadlore-motion.html): patriotic and American-history T-shirts
- [The Docket](https://penloomstudio.com/landing-the-docket-motion.html): plain-English law and consumer-rights news
- [Penloom Works](https://penloomstudio.com/landing-penloom-works-motion.html): a Penloom Studio project
